[[Lieutenant]] '''Mowaat''' was a [[Rodian]] who flew alongside [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]], [[Captain]] [[Carson Teva]], Lieutenant [[Baysee]], Lieutenant [[Jensu]], and Lieutenant [[Lander (individual)|Lander]] in an [[Incident on Seatos|unauthorized mission]] to [[Seatos]]. After the group detected the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', a massive [[Hyperspace transport ring|hyperdrive docking ring]], exiting the [[atmosphere]] of Seatos, the group flew to cross its axis and block its path. The unit failed and suffered casualties with the ''Sion'' entering [[hyperspace]] through the group. Mowaat's X-wing collided with the X-wing of Baysee, killing the pair of them.<ref name="Part Four: Fallen Jedi" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mowaat first appeared in the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' which was released on [[September 5]], [[2023]]. Mowaat was portrayed by [[Dawn Dininger]].<ref name="Part Four: Fallen Jedi />
